facts.business: Kairosoft AI Solutions Limited is a BSE-listed enterprise AI platform company building India's enterprise AI infrastructure under the Volkai platform, delivering AI-native products for hiring (Volkai HR), campus placement (Volkai College), custom enterprise AI & agents, and R&D in voice, vision, and agentic AI.
